citations.quote: This decomposition of operating profitability is known as the DuPont model.
Just as financial liabilities can lever up the ROCE, so can operating liabilities lever up the return on net operating assets.
DuPont analysis shows the relationship between the various categories of ratios discussed in this reading and how they all influence the return to the investment of the owners.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Framing the 3-step DuPont identity (ROE = Net Margin × Asset Turnover × Financial Leverage) and the 5-step extension that splits net margin into tax burden × interest burden × EBIT margin. Sector profiles diverge sharply on which decomposition component carries the ROE; sustainability differs by lever.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Ratio Decomposition (DuPont)
